facts.fact: 神庙结构：entry hall→womb-chamber——Phos 把神庙改成 Conjuration circles 序列（Dawn Throne 居中）——耀斑已毁其半——「If he possesses us now, then his physical body becomes vulnerable.」
facts.anchor: If he possesses us now, then his physical body becomes vulnerable

facts.fact: 三连撞盾：Angelica 元素环/Risha 镰+魂/Dante 影——Phos 盾自修复——Fin 掷石三连喝「Our city—our families—our bodies!」
门外危机与 negation：Phos 开绝对空间门——Azideh 认符：「It is the symbol for negation. The same symbol that became instrumental in isolating your realms.」——Julian 画八线圆 freeze 门。
facts.anchor: It is the symbol for negation

facts.fact: 门后真相：Dante 窥门——碎片悬绕 radiant core——「This is Ostium」「Was,」Azideh corrected——毁灭的初神之家。
原型门刀：Dante 提议便携 lightspeed gate 刻 glyph——Julian 献血（blood and magic）——Ulshära 举 Device 激活——金 sheet 切断圈阵、拖 spire 入 Ostium 位面。
神的镜问：POWER/FREEDOM/REVENGE 三人点名——「HOW IS YOUR REBELLION ANY DIFFERENT THAN OURS?...WITH YOU CONTINUING THE CYCLE.」
facts.anchor: HOW IS YOUR REBELLION ANY DIFFERENT THAN OURS?

facts.fact: Taesia 的回答：「You're wrong.」「The cycle ends here. And I, for one, am going to make a fucking holiday out of it.」——真黑球碎盾上半。
章末：白金流星自上而落——矛穿神右眼直钉王座——「Cracks splintered outward」——Rian 的惊呼代言众人——「Nikolas.」
